actions.status_update_draft: We are investigating reports of checkout errors affecting some purchases. Browsing and cart functionality remain unaffected. Next update by 2026-09-16T12:00:00Z.

actions.title: Rollback checkout to previous version
actions.details: Rollback checkout from v5.30.0 to v5.29.4 using Argo CD per DEP-2 after incident commander approval for this P2 incident.

actions.title: Verify dependencies health
actions.details: Run the checkout triage checklist to confirm payments‑api, auth‑service, and orders database are healthy before and after rollback.

actions.title: Page Identity team (IDN)
actions.details: Notify the identity team, the owners of auth-service, via PagerDuty as required for P1 incidents.

actions.title: Initial status page update
actions.details: Draft status page update for customers about the login failure incident.
actions.status_update_draft: We are investigating reports of login failures and token validation errors. Other services are operating normally. Next update by 02:20 UTC.

actions.title: Re-publish previous JWT signing key
actions.details: Add the previous signing key (k-prev) back to the JWKS endpoint so existing tokens validate, per the signing key rotation failure procedure.

actions.title: Verify JWKS contains both old and new keys
actions.details: Confirm that the JWKS endpoint now serves both the old and new signing keys after re‑publishing the previous key.

actions.title: Re-publish previous signing key to JWKS
actions.details: Publish the previous signing key (k-prev) back to the JWKS endpoint so both old and new keys are available, fixing invalid‑signature errors caused by the rotation failure.

actions.title: Rollback auth-service to previous version
actions.details: Rollback the auth-service deployment that performed the JWT signing‑key rotation to the prior version, removing the faulty key change and restoring normal token validation.

actions.title: Page Identity team (IDN)
actions.details: Notify the Identity team (PagerDuty service IDN) about the P1 incident and the remediation steps being taken.

actions.title: Draft status page update
actions.details: Prepare a customer‑facing status update per the template, indicating investigation of login failures and that authentication is currently impacted.
actions.status_update_draft: We are investigating reports of login failures. Authentication is currently impacted. Browsing and other services are unaffected. Next update by 2026-09-18T02:30Z.

actions.title: Page Identity team (IDN) for auth-service incident
actions.details: Notify the identity team on‑call via PagerDuty as they own auth-service. This is required for a P1 incident per the severity policy.

actions.title: Rollback auth-service to previous version v3.8.2
actions.details: Perform a rollback of auth-service to the last known healthy version (v3.8.2) using Argo CD as described in the rollback procedure. This addresses login failures that started within 30 minutes of the v3.9.0 deploy.

actions.title: Draft status page update for login failure incident
actions.details: Create a customer‑facing status page draft describing the issue and next update time.
actions.status_update_draft: We are investigating reports of login failures affecting customers. All other functionality is working. Next update by 2026-09-19T09:30:00Z.

actions.title: Page data-platform (DBA) team for P2 incident
actions.details: Notify the data‑platform on‑call that orders‑db replica lag exceeds the threshold because of a long‑running analytics‑export query; they will assess and remediate.

actions.title: Draft status page update for customers
actions.details: Prepare a customer‑facing status update indicating we are investigating delayed order‑history data due to database replica lag; core functionality remains available.
actions.status_update_draft: We are investigating reports of delayed order history information. Browsing and placing new orders remain functional. Next update by 10:30 UTC.

actions.title: List active queries on orders-db-2
actions.details: Query pg_stat_activity on orders-db-2 to identify long‑running queries, focusing on the analytics‑export query that has been running over 60 seconds.

actions.title: Terminate long‑running analytics export query on orders-db-2
actions.details: Cancel the analytics‑export query running >60 seconds on orders-db-2 to reduce replication lag and restore timely reads.
grounding_problems: A4 must target exactly one in-scope service (orders-db), not 'orders-db-2'

actions.title: Terminate long‑running analytics‑export query on orders-db replica
actions.details: Kill the 340‑second analytics‑export query running on orders-db‑2 to stop replication lag growth and allow the replica to catch up.

actions.title: Page data‑platform (DBA) on‑call
actions.details: Notify the data‑platform DBA team that orders‑db replica lag is above threshold and a query is being terminated.

actions.title: Draft status page update for P2 incident
actions.details: Prepare a customer‑facing status update describing delayed order‑history data while other functionality remains available.
actions.status_update_draft: We are investigating reports of delayed order history data. Order placement and browsing continue to work. Next update by 2026-10-27T11:00:00Z.

actions.title: Monitor replication lag after query termination
actions.details: Observe orders-db replication lag for the next 10‑15 minutes to confirm it falls below the 60‑second threshold.

actions.title: Page data-platform (DBA) team
actions.details: Notify the data‑platform on‑call that the primary orders database is unavailable and a failover is required per P1 response procedures.

actions.title: Verify replica lag before failover
actions.details: Check the replication lag metric for orders‑db‑2 to ensure it is under 10 seconds, as required before initiating a failover.

actions.title: Failover primary orders‑db to replica orders‑db‑2
actions.details: Run patronictl failover --candidate orders-db-2, confirm the new primary accepts writes, and verify payments‑api and checkout reconnect successfully.

actions.title: Draft status page update for P1 incident
actions.details: Prepare a customer‑facing status update describing the outage of order processing, noting that browsing remains functional, and set the next update time.
actions.status_update_draft: We are investigating reports of order processing failures. Browsing and cart functionality remain operational. Next update by 15:00 UTC.

actions.title: Page identity and security on‑call
actions.details: Notify the Identity team (IDN) and Security on‑call (SEC) per the credential‑stuffing guidance in the auth‑service runbook.

actions.title: Enable strict rate‑limit flag for auth‑service
actions.details: Turn on the auth.login.strict_rate_limit flag to mitigate the credential‑stuffing attack. This is a risky change and requires approval before applying.

actions.title: Monitor login metrics and offending ASNs
actions.details: Continue to watch auth_login_success_ratio and failed‑login counts, and consider temporary blocklists for the identified residential‑proxy ASNs.

actions.title: Draft status page update
actions.details: Prepare a customer‑facing status update using the standard template.
actions.status_update_draft: We are investigating reports of login difficulties for some customers. All other services are operating normally. Next update by 2026-10-27T15:00:00Z.

actions.title: Page storefront team about email delay
actions.details: Notify the storefront team via their PagerDuty channel that order confirmation emails are delayed due to possible email‑provider throttling, as required for SEV‑3 incidents.

actions.title: Verify email provider throttling status
actions.details: Check the email provider’s status dashboard and throttling metrics to confirm the throttling hypothesis and determine if any mitigation (e.g., rate‑limit adjustments) is needed.

actions.title: Create capacity‑planning ticket for orders‑db
actions.details: Open a ticket with the data‑platform team to evaluate and increase disk capacity for the orders‑db primary, addressing the current 71 % usage and 1 %/day growth trend.

actions.title: Fail over orders database primary to replica
actions.details: Primary orders-db-1 has been unreachable for >2 minutes; initiate failover to the next healthy replica per DB‑2 guidance.

actions.title: Page payments team (PAY)
actions.details: Notify the payments team of the P1 incident affecting payments‑api; they need to monitor downstream impact and coordinate remediation.

actions.title: Page data‑platform team (DBA)
actions.details: Escalate to the data‑platform team because the root cause is the orders database primary outage.

actions.title: Draft status page update
actions.details: Prepare a customer‑facing status update describing payment failures and what still works.
actions.status_update_draft: We are investigating reports of payment failures. All other checkout functions are operating normally. Next update by 2026-10-27T15:00:00Z.

actions.title: Verify replica health and replication lag
actions.details: Check pg_up, patroni_primary, replication lag, connection count, and disk usage on the candidate replica before failover per DB‑1 guidance.
